notes:
Company background: Sapling Sentry builds an in-app product search and recommendations layer for B2B SaaS products (analytics dashboards, feature flags). Mid-market, ~450 employees, HQ SF.

Initial interest: embeddings + semantic search to replace rule-based product search and to power an offline batch job that reindexes customer catalogs nightly. Priority metrics: recall @10, mean latency for top-k retrieval, and batch throughput for nightly reindex (they process ~600k docs/day).

Conversation highlights: 
- 2026-02-18 kick-off call (Samir + Diego) — customer wants Hosted API for quick proof; then evaluate Dedicated for cost predictability. Quote: "We need predictable token costs for nightly reindex — not a surprise bill."
- They run vector DB (self-hosted Milvus) and prefer a connector approach: want Redwood to integrate with S3 + Milvus/Redis as vector cache.
- Concern: peak concurrency during catalog refresh (spikes to ~1200 concurrent embedding calls). Looking for batching recommendations and autoscaling guidance.
- Security: SOC2 compliance required, SSO via Okta, KMS for key management. Data residency: prefer NA but OK with multi-region fallback.

POC ask: 
- 2-week hosted API POC: ingest 50k sample records, run nightly batch reindex, measure tokens/costs, end-to-end recall/latency metrics.
- Test connectors: live sync to Milvus, fallback to hosted vector cache for hot keys.
- Provide recommended Dedicated sizing and estimated monthly cost for their workload.

Internal context / AE notes: 
- Good fit for mid-market motion — self-serve to POC to Dedicated uplift.
- Finance wants an ARR band estimate before legal review. Put $50k-$150k in SFDC.
- SE to prepare a batching + KV cache playbook (Diego). Add sample Jupyter notebook for nightly batch pipeline.

Quotes & red flags: 
- "We need deterministic costs for nightly jobs" — primary procurement driver.
- Red flag: internal infra team insists on validating connector latency to Milvus; may push back if connector requires additional infra changes.

Suggested assets to send: pricing worksheet, hosted POC runbook, security FAQ, sample Milvus connector doc, Fireflies transcripts.

Short-term next steps: 1) Kick off hosted API POC (start week of 2026-03-15) — Samir to send POC scope + creds. 2) SE to deliver batch test harness and sample scripts. 3) Finance to approve provisional ARR band for procurement routing.
